name: Nawab Abdul Latif
role: Muslim education reform advocate in Bengal
contribution: He promoted modern education among Bengali Muslims and encouraged engagement with administrative and intellectual institutions.
context: His interventions came in late-19th-century Bengal when Muslim educational participation lagged behind new colonial systems.
impact: He shaped trajectories of Muslim educational modernization in Bengal.
highlight: A key bridge between Muslim society and modern education.
seoTitle: Nawab Abdul Latif: Muslim Education Reform in Bengal
seoDescription: Explore Nawab Abdul Latif's work for modern education and Muslim participation in Bengal's colonial institutions.
shortAnswer: Nawab Abdul Latif was a Bengali Muslim education reformer who promoted modern learning and institutional participation.
